_comment: Copy to bench.targets.json and fill in your own hosts. Each named target maps to a dict the ssh driver in tests/bench.py understands: jump is passed to `ssh -J …`, host/port/user become `ssh -p PORT USER@HOST`, psi is the absolute path of the psi binary on the remote. Pass --remote NAME to tests/bench.py to pick one; default is `remote` when --remote is given without a name.
